name: Watermark
description: A large faint shape with a small solid one over it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.3% 33.0%, 97.6% 34.5%, 70.0% 56.5%, 79.4% 90.5%, 50.0% 71.0%, 20.6% 90.5%, 30.0% 56.5%, 2.4% 34.5%, 37.7% 33.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.3% 33.0%, 97.6% 34.5%, 70.0% 56.5%, 79.4% 90.5%, 50.0% 71.0%, 20.6% 90.5%, 30.0% 56.5%, 2.4% 34.5%, 37.7% 33.0%); opacity: 0.4; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40%; width: 20%; top: 40%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
